summary: Bank of America filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for a $10 billion medium-term note offering, comprising $500M floating rate senior notes due 2030, $3.25B 4.477% fixed/floating senior notes due 2030, $3.25B 4.695% fixed/floating senior notes due 2032, and $3B 5.489% fixed/floating subordinated notes due 2037. The offering is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5) with no change of control, premium, or special-situation catalyst. Notes are unsecured or subordinated, not exchange-listed. This is routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
